lines.en: : Have you been eating enough potassium?
lines.zh: : 你最近钾摄入够吗？

lines.en: : What’s going on? I thought the game was over.
lines.zh: : 怎么回事？我以为游戏已经结束了。

lines.en: : We have an urgent delivery for someone by the name of Ayane Amamiya. Do we have the correct residence?
lines.zh: : 我们有一批急件要送给一位叫 Ayane Amamiya 的人。请问地址对吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, this is Ayane’s house. I have no idea who any of you are, though. Nor did I hear anything about a delivery. May I ask what’s being dropped off?
lines.zh: : 对，这就是 Ayane 家。不过我完全不知道你们是谁。也没听说过有什么送货的事。能问一下送的是什么吗？

lines.en: : Pardon my manners. We’re with the Produce Delivery Administration. We’re the ones who have been providing her oversized fruits this whole time.
lines.zh: : 失礼了。我们是农产品递送管理局的。一直以来给她供应超大号水果的就是我们。

lines.en: : I’ve got a bone to pick with you guys. She slammed one of those giant bananas down on my table back in Chapter 1 and it’s been all wobbly ever since.
lines.zh: : 我跟你们还有笔账要算。第一章的时候她把那种巨型香蕉砸在我桌上，从那以后那张桌子就一直摇摇晃晃的。

lines.en: : I apologize for the inconvenience, sir. But Left Hand Man is the one who handles all furniture related complaints, so you’re going to have to talk to him.
lines.zh: : 给您添麻烦了，先生。不过所有家具相关的投诉都由左手人负责，所以您得跟他谈。
: 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊……

lines.en: : I don’t know if I want to talk to him. He seems angry.
lines.zh: : 我不确定我想跟他谈。他看起来很生气。

lines.en: : He is, sir. Now, would you be so kind as to tell me where Miss Amamiya is located? I have special orders to not provide the shipment to anyone else.
lines.zh: : 是的，先生。那么，能否请您告诉我 Amamiya 小姐在哪里？我奉特别指示，不得把货交给其他人。

lines.en: : Yeah, she should be right inside with the rest of the girls.
lines.zh: : 嗯，她应该就在里面，跟其他女生在一起。

lines.en: : Oh, and if you see the one with the face mask and kimono, could you tell her to come get me? I wandered off when she went to the bathroom and now I’m thinking of drowning myself in the lake.
lines.zh: : 哦，还有，如果你们看到一个戴面罩、穿和服的，能不能叫她来找我？她去上厕所的时候我走开了，现在我正想着要不要在湖里把自己淹死。

lines.en: : Hey buddy, there’s no need to do anything that drastic. You’re probably just having a mental breakdown. It’ll all blow over soon. Just focus on your breathing. One, two, three-
lines.zh: : 嘿，老兄，没必要做到那种地步。你大概只是精神崩溃了而已。很快就会过去的。专注呼吸就好。一、二、三-

lines.en: : Jesus fucking Christ, Mike. Can we visit {i}one{/i} fucking house without you going all {i}psychiatrist{/i} on somebody?
lines.zh: : 我操你妈的耶稣啊，Mike。我们能不能就他妈拜访{i}一{/i}户人家，而你不对谁摆出那副{i}心理医生{/i}的架势？

lines.en: : Well, {i}excuse me{/i} for wanting to help people, Sharon. I don’t know why you always need to make such a big deal out of this.
lines.zh: : 呵呵，{i}抱歉{/i}我想帮人行不行，Sharon。我不懂你为什么总要把这事闹得这么大。

lines.en: : You flunked out of med school {b}TEN{/b} years ago! You’re not an actual shrink and I’m tired of you pretending to {i}be{/i} one just so you can feel good about yourself!
lines.zh: : 你{b}十{/b}年前就被医学院退学了！你根本不是真正的心理医生，我受够了你为了自我感觉良好就装成{i}心理医生{/i}！

lines.en: : Maybe I wouldn’t {i}have{/i} to do things like this to feel good about myself if my {i}wife{/i} would stop taking all of her issues out on me every single day.
lines.zh: : 要是我{i}老婆{/i}别天天把她的破事都往我身上撒，我也许就{i}不用{/i}靠做这种事来让自己好受了。

lines.en: : And maybe {i}I{/i} wouldn’t {i}have{/i} any issues if my husband didn’t have a permanent erection! Do you have any idea how embarrassing it is to be seen in public with you?!
lines.zh: : 那要是我老公不是一直勃起着，{i}我{/i}也许就{i}不会{/i}有任何破事！你知道跟你一起在公共场合出现有多丢人吗？！
: 他们俩怎么回事？

lines.en: : They take care of the clerical work and all of the actual important stuff. I’m just the face of the company and handle client relations.
lines.zh: : 他们负责文书工作和所有真正重要的事。我只是公司的门面，负责客户关系。

lines.en: : Well, you’re doing a great job. Keep it up.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你做得很好。继续保持。

lines.en: : I appreciate that, sir. Now, come on gang. We’ve got produce to administer the delivery of.
lines.zh: : 谢谢您，先生。好了，伙计们走吧。我们还有农产品要递送呢。
: 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊……

lines.en: : I’m sorry for all of the yelling, Sir. Things don’t usually play out like this.
lines.zh: : 抱歉让您听这些吼叫，先生。平时一般不会闹成这样。

lines.en: : Oh keep it in your fucking pants, Mike!
lines.zh: : 哦，你他妈给我把那玩意儿收进裤子里，Mike！
: 我{i}没有{/i}裤子，Sharon！
: 有意思的人。我喜欢他们。

lines.en: : Oh, shit. Didn’t realize you were out here too. Kinda figured you’d be happily drowning in {s}the lake{/s} all of the attention right now.
lines.zh: : 哦，靠。没想到你也在外面。我还以为你这会儿正开心地沉浸在{s}湖里{/s}所有人的关注中呢。

lines.en: : Hey, Yumi. Did you catch the Produce Delivery Administration on their way in? They were a lot of fun and I think you should talk to them before they disappear forever.
lines.zh: : 嘿，Yumi。农产品递送管理局的人进来时你看见了吗？他们可有意思了，我觉得你该趁他们还没永远消失去跟他们聊聊。

lines.en: : The Produce Delivery Administration. You know. Right Hand Man, Left Hand Man, Mike, and Sharon.
lines.zh: : 农产品递送管理局啊。你知道的。右手人、左手人、Mike 和 Sharon。

lines.en: : Yeah, so, whatever the fuck you’re talkin’ about right now- quit it. Shit ain’t doin’ any favors for my headache.
lines.zh: : 行，所以，你他妈现在说的这些——给我打住。这对我的头疼一点好处都没有。

lines.en: : Sounds like you could use a little more potassium.
lines.zh: : 听起来你得多补点钾。

lines.en: : No. It sounds like I could use some fuckin’ peace and quiet for a few minutes before {i}more{/i} people wind up findin’ out about my birthday.
lines.zh: : 不。听起来我需要的是他妈的清静几分钟，趁{i}更多{/i}人还不知道我生日的事。

lines.en: : Oh, right. I haven’t said “Happy birthday” yet.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。我还没跟你说「生日快乐」呢。
: 酷。别说。

lines.en: : Why not? Even if you don’t want to celebrate, it’s still a day to commemorate your birth. And if you were never born, my life would be slightly worse.
lines.zh: : 为什么不说？就算你不想庆祝，这天终究是纪念你出生的日子。而且你要是从没出生过，我的人生会稍微糟糕一点。

lines.en: : The fuck you get outta {i}my{/i} existence? I’m like the only person here with zero plans to ever sleep with you.
lines.zh: : 你从{i}我{/i}的存在里能得到他妈的什么？我大概是这里唯一一个压根没打算跟你上床的人。

lines.en: : I don’t need to sleep with someone to benefit from their existence. But, funnily enough, I think it’s that exact line of thinking that’s causing my brain to malfunction right now.
lines.zh: : 我不需要跟谁上床才能从他的存在中获益。不过说来好笑，我觉得正是这种思路，让我脑子现在出了故障。
: 你也是，是吧？

lines.en: : I called it a headache a second ago. But whatever the fuck’s goin’ on with me’s a lot weirder than that. Probably just the fuckin’...environment or whatever though.
lines.zh: : 我刚才说是头疼。但我身上发生的这些破事可比那奇怪多了。不过大概只是他妈的……环境什么的吧。

lines.en: : Or maybe Blondie’s got a gas leak or some shit. Fuck if I know.
lines.zh: : 要不就是金发妹家漏气什么的。我他妈哪知道。
: 具体是怎么回事？

lines.en: : It’s kinda hard to describe. Just...lots of deja vu and shit like that.
lines.zh: : 有点难形容。就是……老是既视感之类的破事。

lines.en: : Even this. Feel like I’ve been in this same exact spot before. Just can’t really remember when or why.
lines.zh: : 就连现在也是。感觉我以前来过一模一样的地方。只是记不清是什么时候、为什么。

lines.en: : Come to think of it, that kinda thing’s been happenin’ a lot lately. Ain’t just today.
lines.zh: : 想起来，这种事最近发生得挺频繁的。不只是今天。

lines.en: : But I guess there ain’t no point sayin’ any more to some douche who’s probably seconds away from blackin’ out from whatever the fuck’s goin’ on in {i}his{/i} head.
lines.zh: : 不过我想，跟一个大概再过几秒就会因为{i}他{/i}脑子里那些破事而昏过去的混蛋多说也没意义。

lines.en: : Hey, you should come to my secret apartment soon.
lines.zh: : 嘿，你该找个时间来我的秘密公寓。

lines.en: : Listen, asshole. I ain’t gonna let you flirt with me just cause you’re on the brink of turnin’ into a fuckin’ vegetable, okay? Ain’t no headache strong enough to fuck my judgement up {i}that{/i} bad.
lines.zh: : 听着，混蛋。我不会因为你快要变成一坨他妈的植物人就让你跟我调情，明白吗？再怎么头疼也不至于把我的判断力毁到{i}那种{/i}程度。

lines.en: : I feel like...there’s more I want to say, but...I can’t seem to...find the-
lines.zh: 我觉得……还有更多想说的，但是……我好像……找不到-

lines.en: : Yeah, I’ve got a hard time believin’ there’s anything you could say to make me submit to whatever creepy ass demand that was just now.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我很难相信你还能说出什么，好让我就范于你刚才那个变态要求。

lines.en: : So why don’t we just change topics altogether and you can tell me what the fuck’s goin’ on with you and the temp instead?
lines.zh: : 那我们干脆换个话题吧，你跟我说说你跟那个代课老师到底怎么回事？

lines.en: : The hell was all that shit at her place the other night about? And why did {i}I{/i} wind up gettin’ dragged into it? But, an even better question, since when do you turn down {i}anyone?{/i}
lines.zh: : 那天晚上在她家那些破事到底是怎么回事？还有为什么{i}我{/i}也被拖下水了？不过更好的问题是，你从什么时候开始会拒绝{i}任何人{/i}了？

lines.en: : Wait, Yumi...your headache...I feel like it’s...like it could be important or-
lines.zh: : 等等，Yumi……你的头疼……我觉得它……好像很重要，或者-

lines.en: : Or maybe we can save the whole ass temp conversation for another day too since you’re lookin’ flat out delirious right now and probably shouldn’t be talkin’ at all.
lines.zh: : 或者关于代课老师的整段对话我们也可以改天再聊，毕竟你现在看起来完全神志不清，大概根本不该说话。

lines.en: : Like...seriously, dude. First, you’re gonna tell me about some fuckin vegetable delivery squad...and now you’re gonna turn my weird ass deja vu thing into a big deal? I’m probably just fuckin’ tired or whatever.
lines.zh: : 说真的，老兄。先是你跟我说什么他妈的蔬菜送货队……现在又要把我这奇怪的既视感搞成什么大事？我大概只是他妈的累了什么的。

lines.en: : Just shut your fuckin’ mouth and...go drink some water or some shit. And get me some while you’re at it.
lines.zh: : 闭上你他妈的嘴……去喝点水什么的。顺便也给我来一杯。

lines.en: : Would do it myself, but I’ve been avoidin’ the damn buffet table all night since the fuckin’ green girl’s been over there and I’m trying not to punch her teeth in and get kicked outta school again.
lines.zh: : 我自己去就行了，可我一整晚都在躲那张该死的自助餐桌，因为那个绿头发的妹子一直在那儿，我在努力忍着不把她的牙打掉、再被学校开除一次。
: 绿头发的妹子？你是说 Io？

lines.en: : You know any other green girls?
lines.zh: : 你还认识别的绿头发妹子吗？

lines.en: : Molly’s a little greenish. And a few of the girls have green eyes.
lines.zh: : Molly 有点发绿。还有几个女生是绿眼睛。

lines.en: : I’m obviously talkin’ about the first one, numnuts.
lines.zh: : 我说的显然是第一个，蠢货。

lines.en: : What do you have against the second floor that makes you always want to fight them?
lines.zh: : 你对二楼到底有什么意见，怎么老想跟她们打架？

lines.en: : Okay, you know damn well why I beat the shit outta Nodoka. The floor she sleeps on ain’t got anythin’ to do with it.
lines.zh: : 行，你他妈心里清楚我为什么把 Nodoka 揍了个半死。她睡在几楼跟这毫无关系。

lines.en: : If you tell me Io stole your clothes and tried to blackmail you as well, I’m going to go ahead and buy you a padlock as a belated birthday present.
lines.zh: : 要是你告诉我 Io 也偷了你的衣服、还想敲诈你，那我就直接给你买把挂锁当迟到的生日礼物了。

lines.en: : Ain’t anythin’ like that. She just...fuckin’...
lines.zh: : 不是那么回事。她只是……他妈的……

lines.en: : She, like...laughed at me or whatever. For some of the shit I’ve been through in the past. Made me feel like a fucking loser.
lines.zh: : 她就是……笑我什么的。笑我过去经历过的一些破事。让我觉得自己像个他妈的失败者。

lines.en: : If it was that, I’m honestly a little surprised you {i}didn’t{/i} punch her teeth in. You must be growing up.
lines.zh: : 如果只是那样，说实话我还挺惊讶你居然{i}没有{/i}把她的牙打掉。你一定是长大了。

lines.en: : I ain’t doin’ shit. I just...
lines.zh: : 我才没怎么样。我只是……
: 感觉他妈的{i}很怪{/i}。

lines.en: : Like...she had this look on her face that made me think she’s been through some shit too and...while that doesn’t make it right to laugh at other people...I don’t know. I kinda just...pitied her.
lines.zh: : 就是……她脸上那种表情让我觉得她也经历过一些破事，而且……虽然那不能成为嘲笑别人的理由……我也不知道。我只是有点……同情她。

lines.en: : Either way, my track record ain’t exactly great, so I feel like I might’ve done the same exact thing in her shoes.
lines.zh: : 不管怎么说，我自己的履历也不怎么光彩，所以我觉得换成是她那个处境，我大概也会做一模一样的事。

lines.en: : That was just in the moment, though. Who’s to say I won’t dial shit up if she pulls somethin’ like that again? Just tryin’ to keep my distance for now.
lines.zh: : 不过那只是一时的事。谁说得准她要是再来一次，我不会把事闹大？现在只是想跟她保持距离。

lines.en: : Then boy do I have some bad news for you.
lines.zh: : 那我可有个坏消息要告诉你了。
: 什么？你他妈想-
: Sensei！
: 还有……哦。你也在啊。
: 有问题吗？

lines.en: : Not particularly. I just didn’t think you liked Sensei enough to sneak away from the party just to talk to him. That’s an Io move.
lines.zh: : 倒也没有。我只是没想到你喜欢 Sensei 到会为了跟他说话偷偷从派对上溜出来。那是 Io 才会做的事。

lines.en: : I didn’t {i}sneak away{/i} to be with him! He just happened to be here when I-
lines.zh: : 我才没有{i}偷偷溜出来{/i}找他！只是我来的时候他刚好在这儿-

lines.en: : Cool! Then leave and go be mean somewhere else. I’ll talk to him since I actually {i}enjoy{/i} his company.
lines.zh: : 酷！那你走吧，去别的地方刻薄。我来跟他说话，因为我{i}确实很享受{/i}有他作伴。
: 跟 Yumi 道歉，Io。
: 嗯？为什么？

lines.en: : Yo! Don’t fuckin’ {i}tell{/i} people to apologize to me! I’m perfectly capable of handlin’ shit like this on my own.
lines.zh: : 喂！别他妈{i}叫{/i}别人跟我道歉！这种事我自己完全搞得定。

lines.en: : Never mind. Don’t do anything, Io. Just keep being you.
lines.zh: : 算了。Io，什么都别做。继续做你自己就好。
: 呃……好。听起来挺简单的。

lines.en: : I’m not, like...interrupting something, am I? Because the whole “He just happened to be here” thing makes me {i}think{/i} I’m not. But you also look kind of serious right now and I can go back to waiting if I have to.
lines.zh: : 我应该没有……打扰到什么吧？因为那句「他刚好在这儿」让我{i}觉得{/i}没有。不过你们现在看起来有点严肃，如果需要的话我可以回去继续等。

lines.en: : You ain’t interruptin’ shit and there ain’t no need to {i}wait.{/i} I was actually just leaving.
lines.zh: : 你什么都没打扰到，也{i}不用{/i}等。我正要走呢。
: 哦。酷。
: 那……回头见。
: 滚蛋。
: Yumi-

lines.en: : You too. I’ll get my own fuckin’ glass of water.
lines.zh: : 你也一样。我自己去倒他妈的水。

lines.en: Yumi wanders off before I’m able to probe further into whatever is going on with her memories and...
lines.zh: Yumi 走开了，我还没来得及追问她记忆里到底出了什么问题，然后……

lines.en: And my brain starts to go back to normal?
lines.zh: 而我的脑子开始恢复正常了？
等等。没有。还是坏的。
: 你看起来……不太一样。
: 哪里不一样？

lines.en: : I’m not really sure. But it’s a little intimidating.
lines.zh: : 我也说不上来。但有点吓人。
: 你怕我？

lines.en: : I’m afraid of everything at pretty much all times. And while that is just generally a sucky thing I have to deal with, it doesn’t mean I’m going to run away from you or anything.
lines.zh: : 我基本上无时无刻不在害怕一切。虽然这大体上是件我不得不忍受的烂事，但也不代表我会从你身边逃走什么的。

lines.en: : You just seem slightly more menacing than normal and I’m not really sure why. Did something happen with Yumi?
lines.zh: : 你只是看起来比平时更有压迫感一点，我不太确定为什么。是 Yumi 那边出什么事了吗？
: Yumi 那边什么都没发生。
: 那是{i}任何人{/i}出什么事了吗？

lines.en: : You were with Touka before. Did something happen with her? Or with any of the other girls? Do you want to leave here and go to a family restaurant or something? I’ll get you coffee.
lines.zh: : 你之前和 Touka 在一起。是她那边出事了吗？还是其他哪个女生？你想不想离开这里，去家庭餐厅什么的？我请你喝咖啡。

lines.en: : You worry too much. I’ll be fine.
lines.zh: : 你担心太多了。我会没事的。

lines.en: : I feel like people are only fine, like...10%% of the times they say they’re going to be fine.
lines.zh: : 我觉得人们说自己「会没事」的时候，大概只有 10% 的时候是真的会没事。

lines.en: : It’s okay to {i}not{/i} be fine, Sensei. I’m a burden to you literally every single time we speak. Let’s go ahead and switch roles for a little while if that’ll help.
lines.zh: : {i}不{/i}没事也没关系，Sensei。我们每次说话，我对你来说都是个负担。要是能帮上忙的话，我们干脆换个角色试试吧。

lines.en: : I’m not sure it will, Io.
lines.zh: : 我不确定有没有用，Io。

lines.en: : And frankly, I think you should stay away from me for the rest of the night.
lines.zh: : 而且老实说，我觉得你今晚剩下的时间都该离我远点。

lines.en: : Wait, did I do something wrong?...
lines.zh: : 等等，我做错什么了吗？……

lines.en: : You’ve opened up to me before, right? Was asking you to do that now crossing a line or something? Where did I go wrong? How did I fuck up?
lines.zh: : 你以前也对我敞开心扉过，对吧？现在让你这么做，是不是越界了什么的？我哪里做错了？我把什么搞砸了？

lines.en: : Tell me so I can try not to do it again. I probably will because I suck and fuck {i}everything{/i} up, but please tell me anyway so I can at least {i}try.{/i}
lines.zh: : 告诉我，这样我才能试着不再犯。我大概还是会犯，因为我很烂、把{i}一切{/i}都搞砸，但求你还是告诉我，好让我至少能{i}试一试{/i}。
